d: France is bracing for another weekend of unrest. Curfews are in place, riot police are on the streets, and the government is preparing to deploy soldiers as fresh protests loom. But this is about more than law and order. The unrest comes as France grapples with mounting public anger, political divisions and a government struggling to push through spending cuts. With talks offering little certainty, will France find a political way out - or resort to a tougher crackdown? Palki Sharma tells you.
